title: Feeding the hungry
hookLine: the Prophet's first words in Medina: spread peace, feed people, pray at night
tomorrow: how do you help someone who's in the wrong?

lines: NOT THE FACE OF A LIAR.
cards: A new boss's first meeting. A new coach's first talk in the locker room. Everyone listens hard, because first words tell you what someone cares about.
Now a crowd at Medina, pushing to see a man who has just arrived: the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. In the crowd is a man named 'Abdullah ibn Salam, who came, he says, with everyone else, just to get a look.
He gets close, studies the newcomer's face, and decides one thing: this is not the face of a liar. Then the Prophet speaks. What comes first?

teach.h: SPREAD PEACE, FEED PEOPLE, PRAY AT NIGHT.
teach.b: 'Abdullah ibn Salam tells it in Jami' at-Tirmidhi. The first thing he heard was a short list.
O people: spread the greeting of peace, feed people, and pray at night while others sleep, and you will enter Paradise in peace. Look at that list. One greeting.
One meal. One quiet prayer in the dark. Nothing on it needs a title or a budget.
A greeting costs nothing. A meal costs a little. A prayer in the dark costs some sleep.
And feeding sits right between a hello and a prayer, as if a plate and a prostration belong in the same breath. The Qur'an praises the same thing.

teach.h: FOR LOVE OF HIM, NO THANKS WANTED.
teach.b: In Pickthall's words, the righteous "feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him." The next verse gives what they say as they do it: we want no reward from you, and no thanks.
That's the detail worth telling a friend tonight. In the Qur'an's picture, the one who feeds isn't even waiting for a thank-you. The meal is the whole point.
So feeding the hungry is a food bank and a fundraiser, yes.
It's also the extra plate when a friend drops by, the lunch split down the middle, the granola bar handed through a car window.

how: Muslims feed people in ordinary and organized ways: an extra plate for guests and neighbors, food shared at the mosque, meals given to the poor, and iftar hosted for those breaking the Ramadan fast.

o: a fund that buys meals for the poor
giving food to someone who needs it
fasting so you know what hunger is

games.q: what's inside the story — tap the pairs.
p: saw a face that wasn't a liar's
feed the needy, orphan and prisoner

s: in the Qur'an, the people who feed the needy expect at least a thank-you
76:9 has them say it plainly: we want no reward from you, and no thanks.
'feed people' sits in the same short list as praying at night
spread peace, feed people, pray while others sleep: that's the report in Tirmidhi.
feeding the hungry only counts when it goes through a charity
charity counts, and so does the extra plate. the hadith just says: feed people.

games.q: your family has a big dinner tonight. your cousin's new coworker is in town alone and texts your cousin for restaurant tips. what does 'feed people' point to?
o: invite her to dinner; one more plate is the hadith in action.
send a good restaurant list; she asked for tips, not for a meal.
wait until you know her; feeding is for people who are close.
games.why: the list was short: spread peace, feed people, pray at night. nothing about knowing them first, and in 76:8 the fed even include a prisoner.

practice: Bring to mind one person you could feed this week: a roommate, a coworker, a neighbor, someone who always skips lunch. See the food in your hand and the moment you pass it over.
Then name the one thing most likely to stop you, and one simple way around it.

wordCard.voice: Feeding the hungry: sharing food with someone who needs it. In 'Abdullah ibn Salam's report, it comes right after the greeting of peace.

orig.note: Arabic: 'feed food', the Prophet's words in 'Abdullah ibn Salam's report.

carryVoice: Your line: feed people. A plate is enough to start, and nobody owes you thanks for it. See you tomorrow.

sources.ref: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2485 (also Ibn Majah 1334): 'Abdullah ibn Salam: his face was not the face of a liar; 'O people, spread salam, feed people, pray at night while people sleep, and you will enter Paradise in peace'

sources.q: feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him

sources.ref: Qur'an 76:9 (we feed you for the sake of Allah only; we want no reward nor thanks)
